propositions: Four hand-built sub-calls construct RunRequest with raw config and no model class, causing them to inherit cfg.model regardless of configured model-class table, bypassing Bedrock routing in favor of direct Anthropic.

overlap-judge dominates plan-review traffic with 18 of 23 LLM calls, all routed to direct Anthropic when a class-only Bedrock configuration is used, making the bypass invisible to operators who believe they have cut over completely.

ticket-digest runs on the store write path (enrich_drain called from event_append and push operations), sending real ticket content to direct Anthropic during routine rebar create/comment calls with no visibility in any gate verdict.

Sub-calls must select from class vocabulary (trivial/standard/frontier) based on prompt shape and execution context rather than inheriting raw cfg.model, with an AST-based provenance guard to prevent future bypassing calls from reintroducing the defect.
All other LLM calls in review-plan, review-code, and verify-completion gates correctly honor the model-class configuration, proving the mechanism works when explicitly applied.
